decisions.reason: As a niche Magento-related add-on with some cross-sell value to existing shop and hosting customers but limited strategic importance, we keep it while its maintenance burden remains modest.
Premium customer support directly strengthens our core service differentiation and uses capabilities we already have, so withdrawal is unlikely.
The software version management tool fits our technical platform and can deepen retention among agencies and developers, so its option value still outweighs its carrying cost.
Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship, close-to-core offering aligned with our direction, making a near-term withdrawal very unlikely.
